supersedes.reason: The productive owner metadata was malformed as PENDENTE and a dedicated L0 owner for the integration test was created only after the first candidate and first GREEN. This lineage correction changes protected inputs and invalidates the prior seal, although no semantic obligation changed.

regime.reason: A mudanca cria um contrato Rust publico e materializa morfologia observavel de duracao.
regime.limitation: O workspace e o contexto conversacional sao partilhados; a independencia e declarada por allowlists e separacao de autoridade, nao por isolamento tecnico forte.

causal_predecessor: Semantic L0, step, preflight and baseline preceded the candidate, but valid ownership metadata and the dedicated integration-test owner were formalized after the first candidate and first GREEN. This revision records that limitation and does not claim fully prospective lineage.

frozen_inputs.lineage_timing: created after the first candidate and first GREEN

observable_scope.public_signature: pub fn format_duration(duration: std::time::Duration) -> impl std::fmt::Display
observable_scope.input_model: A std::time::Duration literal, represented in the contract as integer seconds plus integer nanoseconds.
observable_scope.output_model: The exact Unicode string returned by Display::to_string().
required_properties: inclusive 1 microsecond, 1 millisecond and 1 second unit boundaries
the 300.006 second discriminator against a threshold shifted to 300.010 seconds
the 23 hour 59 minute to 1 day transition
two-decimal rounding without forced trailing zeroes
determinism under repetition and reversed case order
excluded: starting, controlling or observing watch or w
changes to L1, L3 or L4
observable_scope.future_watch_status_binding: out-of-scope; it requires a separate step and fresh observation

unknown_policy.allowed_only_for: Cases explicitly marked opaque whose input cannot be constructed as std::time::Duration or whose result cannot be observed as a complete UTF-8 string.

execution_limits.test_selection: one exact unit test per command

forbidden: executing product, Cargo, watch or w
writing or approving the final verdict
contract_author.inherited_context: Parent task context was inherited; no claim of context isolation is made.

may_write: 02_shell/src/lib.rs when required by the frozen L0
must_not: edit manifest, contract, oracles, mutants or seal
read candidate patch before freezing tests

invalidation: Any change to a frozen input, baseline identity, protected suite, contract or execution-limit policy invalidates the seal from the first affected phase.
